title: What If Magnus Raised a Chess Baby?
post: What if Magnus Carlsen taught a baby chess from day one? Someone already tried it: the Polgar experiment. #chess #magnuscarlsen #juditpolgar #chesstok #prodigy

voice._name: Callum (ElevenLabs premade), eleven_v3 with audio tags in "say"

phrases.text: What if Magnus Carlsen taught a baby chess from day one?
phrases.say: [curious] What if Magnus Carlsen taught a baby chess... from day one?

phrases.text: In 1970, László Polgár said geniuses are made, not born. So his three daughters were homeschooled, mostly in chess.
phrases.say: In 1970, László Polgár said geniuses are made, not born. So his three daughters were homeschooled... mostly in chess.

phrases.text: The youngest, Judit, became a grandmaster at 15. Younger than Bobby Fischer.
phrases.say: [impressed] The youngest, Judit, became a grandmaster at fifteen. Younger than Bobby Fischer.

phrases.text: Later she beat Kasparov. And Magnus.
phrases.say: Later, she beat Kasparov... [whispers] and Magnus.

phrases.text: Magnus started at five. Grandmaster at thirteen.
phrases.say: Magnus started at five. Grandmaster at thirteen.

phrases.text: So a baby with Magnus as its coach? The youngest grandmaster ever was 12. That record would be in trouble.
phrases.say: So a baby with Magnus as its coach? The youngest grandmaster ever was twelve... [laughs] that record would be in trouble.

phrases.text: Could it ever beat Magnus? Tell me, and follow.
phrases.say: [playful] Could it ever beat Magnus? Tell me... and follow.
